jobs.occupation: Certified Welders Wanted – Permanent Positions in Denmark
jobs.description:
About Langkjær Staalbyg A/SLangkjær Staalbyg A/S is an owner-managed company with 45 years of experience in the design, engineering, production and installation of structural steel constructions for both large and small building, construction and industrial projects.Our headquarters are located in Vildbjerg, Denmark, where we carry out all activities related to engineering, production and surface treatment.We are lookingWe are looking for skilled and reliable welders with the following qualifications:
• MAG welding – Process 135. Additional certification in Processes 136/138 is an advantage.
• H-LO45 certification is preferred.
• Alternatively, a minimum qualification in fillet and butt welds on material thicknesses of 3 mm and above.
• Welding certificates for pipes from Ø30 mm are preferred.We offer
• Permanent employment with attractive pay and working conditions under a Danish collective agreement.
• Hourly pay: EUR 26.50, including the 10% optional benefits allowance (Fritvalg).
• Additional 11% pension contribution.
• Possibility of a rotation scheme: 3 weeks working in Denmark followed by 1 week at home.
• Possibility of overtime, paid at an enhanced rate from the first hour.
• Assistance with finding accommodation.Requirements
• Relevant welding experience and valid qualifications as described above.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• A professional and reliable approach to work.
• Good spoken English skills and the ability to communicate effectively in the workplace.
• Be a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit.How to applyPlease send your application and CV to:Email: job@staalbyg.dkFor questions regarding the position, please contact:Martin MunkProduction ManagerMobile: +45 20 80 24 25
